executive.summaryParagraph2: Motivation levels remain stable at 3.95/5, sustaining employee interest in AI-supported learning. Dependency risk is manageable, with 5% of employees classified as high-risk and 64% in the moderate-risk range.
executive.summaryParagraph3: Recommendation: Continue investment in AI training infrastructure while implementing risk mitigation activities focused on employee self-efficacy development.

correlation.title: Strategic Correlations & Analysis
correlation.subtitle: AI Usage Frequency Relationships
correlation.significanceNote: Note: P-value < 0.05 indicates statistical significance. Values with p > 0.05 suggest no reliable relationship.
correlation.metric1Desc: Relationship between frequency of AI tool adoption and sustained employee motivation
correlation.metric2Desc: How AI usage correlates with perceived professional development opportunities
correlation.metric3Desc: Connection between AI frequency and digital confidence levels
correlation.metric4Desc: Tenure effect on AI adoption patterns and frequency
correlation.metric5Desc: How AI usage frequency predicts technology acceptance
correlation.correlationStatement: No strong statistical correlation detected between AI usage frequency and digital self-efficacy (r = -0.07, p = 0.518).
correlation.correlationImplication: This suggests that AI adoption is driven by factors beyond technical confidence, such as organizational encouragement or training quality.
correlation.action: Focus on organizational enablement and structured AI training programs rather than assuming self-efficacy alone drives adoption.
correlation.noSigDescription: AI usage frequency shows no statistically significant correlation with digital self-efficacy.
correlation.noSigAction: Investigate other factors influencing adoption; consider personalized training approaches.
correlation.moderateDescription: There is a moderate positive relationship between AI usage and digital confidence.
correlation.moderateAction: Expand AI training programs selectively; focus on upskilling digitally confident teams.
correlation.strongDescription: Strong correlation indicates digital self-efficacy is a key driver of AI adoption.
correlation.strongAction: Prioritize digital literacy programs; measure self-efficacy improvements as success metric.
correlation.significanceFooter: Note: P-value < 0.05 indicates statistical significance. Coefficients range from -1 (perfect negative) to +1 (perfect positive).
